title: Tesla Roadster Reservations Draw $50,000 Deposits
excerpt: Some customers are paying $50,000 or more to reserve Tesla's upcoming Roadster, despite the final price expected to be much higher.
body_html:
Certain buyers are paying deposits of $50,000 and upwards to secure a reservation for Tesla's upcoming Roadster vehicle.

While the base model of the car does not include features like thrusters or a flight system, the final purchase price is expected to cost several times more than the initial reservation amount. Some prospective buyers have expressed intentions to pursue versions equipped with flying capabilities.
